findings.title: AI gives a wrong street address
findings.explanation: AI says 766 W Pearce; you are at 762 West Pearce Boulevard, Wentzville, MO 63385-1016. Navigation apps and delivery drivers follow the wrong number.

evidence.ai_quote: The search didn't turn up a dedicated listing for Stefanina's, but one third-party directory gives its address as 766 W Pearce, Wentzville, MO 63385.

findings.title: AI gives wrong opening hours
findings.true_value: Mon 11am-8pm, Tue 11am-8pm, Wed 11am-8pm, Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 11am-9pm, Sat 11am-9pm, Sun 11am-8pm
findings.explanation: Thursday closes: AI says 9pm, actually 8pm; Saturday closes: AI says 8pm, actually 9pm. People arrive to a locked door or skip a visit when you are actually open.

evidence.query: Stefanina's Pizzeria Wentzville MO address phone hours specials
evidence.ai_quote: Hours: A Sluurpy listing shows roughly 11 AM opening daily, closing around 8 PM Monday through Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday, and 9 PM Thursday and Friday.

findings.title: AI cannot find your hours
findings.true_value: Mon 11am-8pm, Tue 11am-8pm, Wed 11am-8pm, Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 11am-9pm, Sat 11am-9pm, Sun 11am-8pm
findings.explanation: Your hours are on your website but the engine did not find them, so it tells customers to call or guess.

evidence.ai_quote: The search didn't turn up Stefanina's hours.

findings.title: Your own sources disagree with each other
findings.true_value: Structured data (what search engines and AI read) says Mon not listed, Tue 11am-8pm, Wed 11am-8pm, Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 11am-9pm, Sat 11am-9pm, Sun 11am-8pm; the visible page says Mon 11am-8pm, Tue 11am-8pm, Wed 11am-8pm, Thu 11am-8pm, Fri 11am-9pm, Sat 11am-9pm, Sun 11am-8pm. They disagree on: Mon.
findings.explanation: When your website and its structured data (or a listing) disagree, AI engines pick one at random. Fix the source so there is one answer.

findings.title: AI quotes a deal or price your website does not publish
findings.true_value: Your website publishes no specials or deals.
findings.explanation: This comes from a third-party listing, not from you. If it is stale, customers will expect a price you no longer charge.

findings.title: AI cannot confirm the business is open
findings.explanation: The engine found no current, trustworthy signal that you are open. That gap is what lets a wrong 'closed' answer take hold.

findings.title: AI does not use your official website as a source
findings.explanation: None of the 7 answers from this engine cited stefaninas-wentzville.com. It relied on news articles and third-party directories instead, which is how stale or invented facts get in.
